snippet.title: Scary Cave Diving – Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨 WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4211620/Scary_Cave_Diving/

Can you hold your breath when panic sets in? Experience the ultimate terror of deep-sea cave diving in Scary Cave Diving, a new procedural underwater survival horror game. Scavenge resources, manage your oxygen, and fight to survive as you navigate pitch-black underwater caves stalked by a relentless apex predator!

If you love claustrophobic horror games like Subnautica, Iron Lung, or intense shark games, make sure to add Scary Cave Diving to your Steam Wishlist today!

🎮 ABOUT SCARY CAVE DIVINGScary Cave Diving is an immersive, first-person survival horror experience powered by Unreal Engine. Trapped in a deep, randomly generated underwater labyrinth, your only goal is to find the exit. But the caves are dark, your oxygen is draining quickly, and a massive, hungry shark is tracking your every move through the murky water.

✨ KEY FEATURES:
• Hyper-Realistic Graphics – Stunning underwater lighting and claustrophobic environments.
• Procedural Generation – Modular cave systems mean a fresh nightmare every single dive.
• Oxygen Management – Scavenge for air tanks because every breath counts.
• Fight Back – Find a flare gun to stun the beast, or jump into the arcade-style "Shark Cage" mode with a harpoon gun for sweet revenge!
• Galeophobia Setting – Toggle this feature to swap the terrifying sharks for something less horrifying.
